newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary to announce pre-qualifying tender for K&H.
newsitem.headline: Hungary to announce pre-qualifying tender for K&H.

text.p: Hungary's state privatisation agency APV Rt said on Wednesday it would announce a private pre-qualifying tender for the sale of commercial bank Kereskedelmi es Hitelbank Rt (K&H) on Friday.

Participation at the pre-qualifying tender will be limited to international banks and insurance companies, while winners of the procedure will be allowed to make a due diligence and to bid for an least 25 percent and one share stake, APV said in a statement.
The tender -- pending the finance minister's approval -- will be announced on March 14 while the deadline to submit bids will be April 14, it said.
K&H Bank, one of Hungary's last few state-owned banks on offer, is among the country's leading commercial banks.

Final data for the bank's operation in 1996 were not available but it had a net profit of 1.3 billion forints in the first nine months of 1996, while its balance sheet total was 350 billion forints at the end of November.
